The rulebook notes the number of posts/departments may increase or decrease before selection concludes. Note: the UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS figures above do not add up to the Grand Total for each post - the source table splits an additional portion of vacancies into two further sub-columns (labelled "notional"/87% and "provisional"/13%), whose exact composition is not clearly extractable from the scanned rulebook. content_sections.heading: MPESB Subedar Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidate must be a citizen of India. Non-MP-domicile candidates may apply only under the Unreserved (Open) category, with no reservation or age-relaxation benefit, and a flat maximum age of 33 years. A candidate with more than 2 living children, one of whom was born on or after 26 January 2001, is not eligible (with an exception where a single subsequent delivery results in twins/multiple births).

content_sections.heading: MPESB Subedar Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on the last date of online application (23.09.2026). Ex-Servicemen may deduct their period of armed forces service from actual age, provided the resultant age does not exceed the post's maximum limit by more than 3 years. If a candidate has more than one basis for age relaxation, only the single relaxation giving the maximum benefit will be granted (relaxations are not cumulative). Age relaxation is not available to contractual/honorary staff such as Shiksha Karmi or Panchayat Karmi. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.text: An additional MP Online portal fee applies: ₹60 if the form is filled via an authorized kiosk, or ₹20 if the candidate logs in and fills the form themselves as a registered citizen user. A separate departmental exam/processing fee (₹200 unreserved / ₹100 reserved) applies at the second-stage main written exam for qualified candidates, as per Police Department rules.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Subedar Salary
content_sections.text: All Subedar and Sub Inspector cadre posts (SAF, DEF, Arms, Photo, QD, Finger Print) carry Pay Level 9: ₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800. During the 3-year probation period, stipend is payable at 70% of minimum pay in year 1, 80% in year 2, and 90% in year 3, plus other allowances as approved by the government from time to time. Employees appointed on or after 01.01.2005 are covered under the Defined Contribution Pension Scheme.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Subedar Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for MPESB Subedar & Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 is conducted in two stages. Objective/MCQ type, 100 marks, 2-hour duration, no negative marking. Subjects: Hindi language comprehension, English language comprehension, Analytical ability, History, Geography, Science, Civics, Basic computer knowledge, Reasoning, Current Affairs. Separate merit lists are prepared for non-technical and technical posts; candidates equal to 10 times the advertised vacancies (per vertical category: UR/OBC/ST/SC/EWS) are called for the Main Exam. A 5% bonus mark is available at this stage only for specified categories (dependents of soldiers killed in recent India-Pakistan conflict, ex-servicemen, census/election-surplus staff, NCC "C" certificate holders, and returnees from Myanmar/Sri Lanka, among others). Main Written Exam: Two compulsory papers (Paper I & II) of 300 marks each (600 total) for all non-technical and technical posts, 2 hours each. Technical-post candidates (Group-1: SI-Arms; Group-2: SI-Photo/QD/Finger Print) also take an additional Paper III (300 marks) based on Mechanical Engineering (for Arms) or Mathematics/Physics/Chemistry (for Photo/QD/Finger Print). Objective type; 1/3 mark negative marking for wrong answers. Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Compulsory for all candidates, 100 marks total - 800m race (max 40 marks), Long Jump (max 30 marks, 3 attempts), Shot Put (max 30 marks, 3 attempts). Minimum qualifying marks: 30 for non-technical posts, 20 for technical posts. Candidates equal to 3 times the advertised vacancies (per category) based on Main Exam merit are called for PET and Interview. Interview: 50 marks, conducted by a selection committee for candidates who clear PET and document verification. The final merit list is based on Main Exam, PET, and Interview marks combined (using a Normalised Equi-Percentile scaling method for multi-shift/multi-stage exams), with document verification conducted after PET. Candidates must have no knock-knee or flat feet and must be certified medically fit by the District Medical Board. No relaxation is available in the minimum physical standards on health or any other grounds.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPESB Subedar & Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board, on behalf of the Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department, to fill 507 Subedar and Sub Inspector (SAF/DEF/Arms/Photo/QD/Finger Print) posts in Madhya Pradesh Police.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPESB Subedar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 507 posts are advertised: 81 Subedar, 69 SI (SAF), 312 SI (DEF), 10 SI (Arms), 9 SI (Photo), 4 SI (QD), and 22 SI (Finger Print).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPESB Subedar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 23.09.2026, with a correction window open until 28.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MPESB Subedar posts?
faq.answer: Subedar, SI (SAF), and SI (DEF) require a graduate degree or equivalent. SI (Arms) requires a 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. SI (Photo/QD/Finger Print) require a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPESB Subedar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 23.09.2026, the maximum age is generally 33 years for unreserved male/EWS/other-state candidates, 38 years for MP-domicile women and reserved-category men, and up to 43 years for certain relaxation categories such as inter-caste marriage or Vikram Award winners.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MPESB Subedar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for Unreserved candidates and ₹250 for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates (MP domicile only), plus a small MP Online portal fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for MPESB Subedar & Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the MPESB website (www.esb.mp.gov.in) between 09.09.2026 and 23.09.2026 by filling the form, uploading photo/signature, and paying the fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MPESB Subedar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Preliminary Written Exam, a Main Written Exam, a Physical Efficiency Test (800m race, long jump, shot put), and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for MPESB Subedar & Sub Inspector posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are placed in Pay Level 9 (₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800), with a graded stipend during the 3-year probation period.

faq.question: Q10. Is Madhya Pradesh domicile mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MP domicile is mandatory to claim reservation or age-relaxation benefits. Non-domicile candidates may still apply, but only under the Unreserved category with a maximum age of 33 years and no relaxation.
